Messages.Author: Uffdaa
Messages.Body:
Hi, in the Event for the Grand Prix Malmö event I entered in Type: Grand Prix

However now when I try to upload the Archon the following message appears:

Tournament level 'Standard Constructed' of level 'Constructed' inserted in archon does not match with the type 'Grand Prix' inserted on calendar: please check and modify tournament level accordingly, then upload your archon again.

A bit lost here in what to do, so any help would be appreciated.

This is a known bug.
You need to hack the archon to be able to submit a GP result for now by replacing for instance "Demo" by "Grand Prix" in the hidden columns.
Or send the archon to
